hotel.name: Asteria Grand Hotel
hotel.tagline: Calm luxury on the Calangute coast
hotel.description: Asteria Grand Hotel is a boutique beachfront stay in Calangute, Goa. The property is designed for unhurried mornings, quiet evenings, and staff who actually remember your name.
hotel.location: Calangute, North Goa, a short walk from the beach

amenities.name: Swimming pool
amenities.details: Outdoor lagoon pool, open 7:00 AM–8:00 PM. Towels are provided at the pool deck.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.details: Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, including all rooms and public areas.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.details: Complimentary on-site parking for hotel guests, subject to availability.

amenities.name: Fitness center
amenities.details: 24-hour fitness studio with cardio equipment and free weights.

amenities.name: Breakfast
amenities.details: Breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM in the Garden Room. It is included with Deluxe King, Family Room, and Executive Suite stays. Standard Queen guests may add breakfast for ₹950 per adult per morning.

amenities.name: Restaurant
amenities.details: The Garden Room serves coastal Indian and Mediterranean dishes for breakfast, lunch, and dinner. In-room dining is available from 7:00 AM to 11:00 PM.

amenities.name: Airport transfer
amenities.details: Paid airport transfers can be arranged to and from Goa International Airport (GOI). Please request at least 12 hours in advance through the front desk or stay@asteriagrand.example.

policies.cancellation: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before 3:00 PM on the check-in date. Cancellations made after that, or no-shows, are charged for the first night.
policies.pets: Pets are not permitted, with the exception of trained service animals.
policies.smoking: Asteria Grand is a non-smoking hotel. Smoking is permitted only in the designated outdoor courtyard.
policies.children: Children of all ages are welcome. Guests 12 and under stay free when sharing existing bedding with adults. A crib can be requested subject to availability.
policies.extraBed: A rollaway bed can be added to the Executive Suite only, for ₹1,500 per night, and does not increase the published maximum occupancy.
policies.earlyCheckIn: Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may carry a fee. Please contact the front desk to request either.

rooms.name: Standard Queen
rooms.description: A bright, compact room with a garden-facing window, a queen bed, and everything needed for a short coastal stay.

rooms.name: Deluxe King
rooms.description: A quieter king room with a sitting nook, rainfall shower, and breakfast included each morning.

rooms.name: Family Room
rooms.description: Our most requested room for small families and friends travelling together, with a king bed plus a sofa bed.

rooms.name: Executive Suite
rooms.description: A separate living room, king bedroom, and daybed, with a partial sea view and breakfast included.

faqs.question: What time is check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in begins at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included?
faqs.answer: Breakfast is included with Deluxe King, Family Room, and Executive Suite. Standard Queen guests can add it for ₹950 per adult per morning.

faqs.question: Do you have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes. The outdoor lagoon pool is open from 7:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

faqs.question: Can I cancel for free?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you cancel at least 24 hours before 3:00 PM on the check-in date.
